title: Isolation of slow-cycling cancer cells from lung patient-derived xenograft using carboxyfluorescein-succinimidyl ester retention-mediated cell sorting
protocol: Take a frozen lung PDX sample out from a liquid nitrogen storage tank.
Incubate the frozen lung PDX sample in a 37°C water bath for 1 min.
Place a 60 mm culture dish on ice in a biological safety cabinet (BSC).
Transfer the thawed lung PDX sample to the culture dish with 5 ml of complete culture media.
Mince the PDX sample into 2-3 mm³ pieces with a sterile surgical scalpel and keep it aside on ice.
Anesthetize 6–8-week-old female NOD/SCID mouse by injecting the anesthesia cocktail at 100 μL per 10 g of body weight.
Remove hair from the right flank of the NOD/SCID mouse with clippers.
Make a 10-15 mm skin incision on the shaved region using surgical scissors.
Push a trocar needle to secure enough space under the skin.
Load 3-5 pieces of PDX samples on the tip of a stainless-steel trocar needle.
Add 20 μL of Matrigel over the loaded tissues.
Inject the tissue and Matrigel subcutaneously into the NOD/SCID mouse.
Close the surgical region with a sterile suture.
Return the mouse to the cage and monitor until fully recovered.
Remove the suture by 10-14 days after surgery.
Observe PDX tumor growth until it reaches an appropriate size (<500 mm³).
Anesthetize the PDX-bearing mouse by injecting an anesthesia cocktail of 100 μL per 10 g of body weight.
Shave around the PDX tumor with clippers.
Disinfect the surgery area with a 70% ethanol cotton swipe.
Dissect the flank skin and detach the PDX tumor.
Place the collected PDX tumor in 5 mL of complete culture media in a 15 mL conical tube for temporary storage or transport.
Keep the sample in ice (4°C).
Place the PDX tumor in a 60 mm culture dish on ice with 5 mL of complete culture media.
Mince the PDX tumor into several small pieces of ∼2–4 mm with a sterile scalpel.
Prepare human Tumor Dissociation Kit component enzymes by adding culture media according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Aliquot enzyme solutions with appropriate volume and store at -20°C.
Mix chopped PDX tumor with RPMI 1640 media, Enzyme H, Enzyme R, and Enzyme A in a gentleMACS™ C tube.
Attach the C tube to the gentleMACS™ dissociator and run program h_tumor_01.
Incubate C tube in a 37°C CO2 incubator for 30 min while inverting every 5 min.
Attach the C tube to the gentleMACS™ dissociator and run program h_tumor_02 (1st round).
Detach the C tube and incubate in a 37°C CO2 incubator for 30 min while inverting every 5 min.
Attach the C tube to the gentleMACS™ dissociator and run program h_tumor_02 (2nd round).
Detach the C tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 1 min at room temperature (RT, 22 ± 2°C) to collect the dissociated cells.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 10 ml of culture media (complete RPMI 1640) and transfer into a cell strainer (70 μm) placed on a 50 ml conical tube.
Add 10 ml of culture media (complete RPMI 1640) to wash cells through the strainer.
Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 300 × g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant completely and resuspend the pellet in 5 ml of cell culture media (complete RPMI 1640).
Add DNase at 200 U/mL to the cell suspension if it is viscous, and incubate for 5 min at RT (optional).
Add 100 μL of 0.4% trypan blue solution to 100 μL cell suspension.
Load 10 μL of cell suspension on a hemocytometer and count the viable (unstained) cells.
Seed 0.5–1 × 10^7 viable cells per a 90 mm culture dish with 10 mL complete culture media.
Incubate cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for -12 to 24 h.
Remove unattached dead cells and floating murine-immune cells with 5 mL of PBS twice.
Add 1 mL of 2× TE solution to detach the viable cells from the culture dish.
Incubate the cells in 37°C CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Add complete culture media of two times the volume of 2× TE solution.
Transfer the detached cells to a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 300 × g for 7 min at RT.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend and wash the cell pellet with 5 mL PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 7 min at RT.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells at 2–20 × 10^7 cells/mL in sterile PBS.
Prepare a 5 mM CFSE stock solution by adding 36 μL of anhydrous DMSO to 100 μg of lyophilized CFSE.
Dilute the stock solution to prepare a 2× concentration of CFSE working solution (10–200 μM) in PBS for cell resuspension.
Mix the cell suspension well with the 2× CFSE working solution to stain the cells.
Incubate the stained cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 20 min.
Tap the staining tube every 5 min during incubation for mixing.
Quench the CFSE staining by adding complete culture media containing 10% FBS in a volume at least five times that of the staining volume.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 7 minutes.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cells with fresh complete media.
Seed 1–5 × 10^5 cells per a 90 mm culture dish.
Incubate the seeded cells for up to 5 days.
Monitor floating dead cells and perform media change prior to photography after day 0.
Determine the incubation end point before ∼50%–60% of cells lose their fluorescence during proliferation.
Observe under a fluorescent microscope to decide the incubation endpoint.
Detach the stained cells with 1 mL of 2× TE buffer.
Incubate the cells in a 37°C CO2 incubator for 5 min.
Add 2 mL of complete culture media to collect detached cells in a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300 × g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 5 mL PBS for washing.
Centrifuge the washed cells at 300 × g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with 3 mL PBS.
Load 10 μL of cell suspension on a hemocytometer for cell counting.
Transfer a desirable number of CFSE-stained cells to a new sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the transferred cells at 300 × g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with sterile flow cytometry buffer at 10^6 cells/100 μL.
Stain the cells with murine CD45-APC, CD31-APC, and PDGFRα-APC antibodies at 1:200 dilution at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Keep the cells protected from light during staining.
Add 1 mL flow cytometry buffer to the stained cells and centrifuge at 300 × g for 7 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and wash the cell pellet with 1 mL flow cytometry buffer.
Centrifuge again at 300 × g for 7 minutes.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Wash the cell pellet one more time with 1 mL flow cytometry buffer.
Centrifuge a final time at 300 × g for 7 minutes.
Remove all supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in flow cytometry buffer to achieve a concentration of 1–4 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Critical: Ensure the recommended cell concentration is 0.5–1 × 10^6 cells in 250–1,000 μL flow cytometry buffer for optimal separation efficiency.
Transfer the resuspended cells into a FACS tube strainer cap.
Note: Use sterile FACS tubes and their strainer caps to avoid contamination.
Sort the cells using the FACS Aria cell sorter III.
Select APC-negative cell populations.
Divide the selected cell populations into three regions based on FITC intensity: FITC high, FITC middle, and FITC low.
Prepare sterile 15 mL conical tubes as collection reservoirs with 6 mL complete cell culture media.
Wet the walls of the collection tube with cell culture media before sorting.
Collect the sorted cells in sterile collection tubes.
Centrifuge the sorted cells at 300 × g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the sorted cells with 5 mL of fresh culture media.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 7 min.
Resuspend the cells with 3–5 mL of culture media depending on the cell pellet size.
Seed 200 cells of CFSEhigh, CFSEmid, and CFSElow in a 12 well plate (200 cells/1 mL culture media).
Incubate the 12 well plate in a 37°C 5% CO2 incubator for 4 days.
Aspirate the cell culture medium from the wells.
Wash the cells with 1 mL PBS.
Remove the PBS and wash the cells again with another 1 mL PBS.
Completely remove all traces of PBS from the wells.
Fix the cells with 100% methanol for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the methanol from the well.
Stain the cells with a 0.5% crystal violet solution for 1 hour at room temperature.
Remove the staining solution from the wells.
Wash the remaining staining solution with 3 mL of distilled water three times.
Analyze the stained CFSElow, CFSEmid, and CFSEhigh cells.
